# Ascent Wealth

> Ascent Wealth is a registered Mutual Fund Distributor (ARN-109866) and wealth management consultancy in Chennai, India. We provide goal-based financial planning, SIPs, insurance, and fixed-income investment guidance.

- [Disclaimer](https://ascentwealth.in/disclaimer) - Regulatory compliance, general information, and AMFI registered status disclaimer.
